items.title: Ashley Keating and Allan Whitworth Interview, 1963-03-22
items.q: whether they played Gettysburg March instead of Bill Bailey or not

ctx.x: That's why we're on the set.

From what I've seen, I...I wouldn't really term too many of them dedicated. I'd say this is just an on-the-spot review. I may live to regret this, but I'd say the Negro ones, which are the only ones I've really heard since I've been here, seem to play this way because they know no other way. But if there's a big crowd, they appear to me to certainly make concessions towards them. Perhaps it's through years of scuffling and hard going that they think they have to. Personally, I don't think they do. I think they'd…
I see. Back to the Bay City New Orleans Jazz Band, does it have any kind of San Francisco inspiration?
